01 What we heard

Your goals, in your words.

This scope is built around what you told us on November 12. Everything that follows traces back to one of these.

  • The goalGrow from roughly $4M a year toward $6–7M, and carry the brand to Carlsbad.
  • The guestA 30–50 crowd that comes for the game, stays for dinner, and comes back for the night.
  • The gapsNo content before or after your events, no reels that travel, and an in-bar TV loop that needs a refresh.
  • The untapped assetA $50K Frontwave Arena ticket bank that isn’t working for you yet.
  • The calendarNew Year’s Eve, Clippers nights at Frontwave, the Super Bowl on February 14, Carlsbad in 2027, and Vista after that.
  • The creativeGraphics in every format: 11×17 print, table tents, TV screens, stories and square posts, plus branded visuals for each recurring night.
  • The ticketingMove off Eventbrite onto your own ticket pages, paid straight into your account, with every buyer in your own list.
02 The structure

One foundation. Two ways to start.

The Full-Service Partnership from our proposal stays at $9,500, now defined line by line. Everything new from our meeting is available two ways: bundled into the Growth Partnership, or added only when you want it.

Option 03 · As proposed

Full-Service Partnership

Your outsourced marketing department.

Content, event marketing, paid ads, CRM and automation, and local search, run as one system by one team.

  • 1 production day a month with Lo and Walter
  • 2 event nights covered by our content team
  • 10 short-form videos, 8 photo posts and weekly lineups
  • Graphics in every format for each promoted event
  • 4 event promotions, each with its own ticket or RSVP page
  • Meta and Google ads, CRM, texts and email, local search
  • Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn kept active
Monthly$9,500
Partner setup$2,500$1,000
New · Built from our meeting

Growth Partnership

Everything you asked for, in one plan.

Everything in Full-Service, plus the priorities you raised: more live coverage, the Frontwave Arena program, and corporate bookings.

  • Everything in Full-Service, plus
  • 4 event nights covered (instead of 2)
  • 12 short-form videos, with a recap of every covered night
  • 6 ticket or RSVP pages (instead of 4)
  • The Frontwave ticket-bank program
  • LinkedIn push for corporate and group bookings
Monthly$12,500
Partner setup$2,500$1,000

Either option can add services from the menu when you need them, with no monthly commitment. Ad spend goes directly to Meta and Google and is not part of our fee. You can move between the two at the start of any month.

Three kinds of event work

Fill the room. Capture it. Go big when it counts.

05 How event work is defined

Three terms, three jobs.

01

Event promotion

Fills the room

The marketing behind an event: graphics, a ticket or RSVP page, texts, emails and ads. Featured events run the full six-move campaign: pre-announce, headline reveal, artist collab, live coverage, recap, re-engagement.

4 a month in both options
02

Night coverage

Captures the night

One creator from our content team on site for up to 3 hours: photos, vertical video, live Stories, and a recap that posts within 48 hours.

2 a month in Full-Service · 4 in Growth
03

Headline production

For your biggest nights

A photographer and a videographer for up to 3 hours, a recap film, 4 short cuts and 40 edited photos. Built for New Year’s Eve, the Super Bowl and major shows.

Add-on · $2,600 per event

07 Ticketing

From Eventbrite to your own pages.

What changes

  • Every event gets a branded Junkyard ticket or RSVP page
  • Payments go straight to your own Stripe account as tickets sell
  • Every buyer lands in your CRM, ready for the next event
  • QR-code check-in at the door, with refunds handled in the same system

Why it matters

  • You own the guest list instead of renting it
  • Confirmation, reminder and thank-you texts run automatically
  • Ticket sales show up in your monthly report next to revenue
  • The only thing you give up is Eventbrite’s marketplace listing

10 Commercial terms

Clear terms, for both sides.

  • InvestmentFull-Service $9,500/month or Growth $12,500/month, plus the $1,000 partner setup. Pricing holds through November 30, 2026.
  • TermA 3-month initial term, December 1, 2026 to February 28, 2027, then the results review. Renewal is for 6 months with rates locked through month 6.
  • PaymentSetup and month 1 are due at signing. After that, invoices go out monthly in advance, due on the 1st. Work pauses on any invoice more than 10 days late.
  • Ad spend & pass-throughsAd spend ($1,500–2,500/month recommended) is paid directly to Meta and Google. Text and email sending fees, card processing and creator fees are paid at cost. Printing at cost + 15%.
  • ChangesNew requests go to Lo. Each one is included, an add-on at menu price, or quoted, and confirmed in writing before work starts. One round of revisions per piece.
  • FlexibilityMove between Full-Service and Growth at the start of any month with 15 days’ notice. An unused event night rolls forward one month.
  • OwnershipJunkyard owns all final content and its CRM data once paid.
  • ResultsWe commit to every deliverable and to tracking every result. We don’t guarantee attendance, bookings or revenue.
